_help: Testimony manifest. Edit through the admin editor. Only entries with published:true render on the site. Order: most recent publishedAt first. Each entry must include all fields shown in the example below. Set anonymous:true to display the author as 'Anonymous' (the name field is still kept privately for the team's internal records). The 'consent' field records how the submitter agreed to publication ('explicit' = checked the consent box on the form, 'verbal' = obtained off-system).
